briefing.headline: An AWS product marketing req landed in Boston — that's the single best-aligned role on the board today.
briefing.focus: Spend the first 10 minutes on the two Boston/remote bullseyes the keyword score under-rated: AWS Storage PMM (Boston, Amazon = the country's largest H-1B sponsor) and Twilio's Marketing Analyst, PLG (remote-US, and the cleanest bridge between your PMM history and the analytics MBA). Then fire off CarGurus B2B Marketing Specialist — Boston HQ, non-senior, B2B demand-gen, exactly your level. If you have time left, Stripe Lifecycle (Capital) is the only role here where your banking/fintech domain is a hiring argument, not just background.
